guide.title: TPC Colorado: Golf in Berthoud, Colorado
guide.intro: Golf Digest's 2025-'26 Best in State ranking for Colorado labels thirteen courses ahead of TPC Colorado "Private." TPC Colorado, in Berthoud, Larimer County, is the first entry on that list carrying Golf Digest's own "Public" label, at #14. It is not, however, an unrestricted public course: TPC Colorado is a members-first club, non-members book by phone up to seven days ahead, and the club's own page reserves Thursday through Sunday to its membership and the TPC Network, releasing any leftover tee times to the public only 24 hours in advance. A traveller who wants a guaranteed round on a Saturday or Sunday, rather than a leftover time confirmed the day before, should plan on Mariana Butte Golf Course, a City of Loveland municipal course, as the practical weekend round instead.

sections.heading: Getting there
sections.body: From Denver International Airport (DEN), the driving distance to Berthoud, Colorado is 53 miles. By road: north on I-25 to Exit 250 at Johnstown, then west on Colorado State Highway 56 for 9.5 miles to its western terminus at US 287 in Berthoud. Northern Colorado Regional Airport (FNL), between Loveland and Fort Collins, has no scheduled commercial airline service, so DEN is the airport for this trip.

sections.heading: TPC Colorado
sections.body: Arthur Schaupeter Golf Course Architects designed TPC Colorado's championship course. The club's own site gives the par-72 layout as stretching to more than 7,991 yards from the tournament tees and playing from 4,157 yards forward. No opening year is published here: the ASGCA's own account of the project says only that a grand opening was "scheduled for 2018," which is not a record of when the course actually opened, and the operator's own site states no opening year at all. What is confirmed is that the Korn Ferry Tour has played TPC Colorado every year since 2019, under three tournament names in sequence — TPC Colorado Championship, The Ascendant presented by Blue, and The Blue Championship, with Blue Federal Credit Union named title sponsor of the event starting in 2026. The surrounding Heron Lakes community is home to one of the largest Great Blue Heron rookeries in Colorado; more than 90 acres there are dedicated land that cannot be developed, part of a conservation partnership among GOCO, the Town of Berthoud, the City of Loveland, Larimer County and Colorado Parks and Wildlife. That is a conservation designation, not a historic one — no historic designation was found for the property. On site, the club names three dining outlets: Center Stage & 773 Prime, overlooking the water by the 16th hole; the Golf Café; and the Waterfront Grill.

sections.heading: Playing it as a visitor
sections.body: TPC Colorado is not an unrestricted public course. Non-members book by phone on (970) 663-5063, up to seven days in advance. The club states that non-member tee times are available Monday through Thursday after 11:00 AM and Friday through Sunday after 1:00 PM, subject to availability. It also states that Thursday through Sunday are reserved for TPC Colorado members and the TPC Network, with any remaining starting times released for sale only 24 hours in advance. The club's own wording places Thursday in both categories, so a Thursday time should be confirmed by phone. There is no lodging requirement: nothing on the club's site conditions play on a hotel or resort stay, and TPC Colorado has no lodging of its own — the property is a golf course, clubhouse and residential community. The club quotes its own rate when you call to book; no green fee is published here, since no figure found for TPC Colorado carries a date or a season.

sections.heading: Day two: Mariana Butte Golf Course
sections.body: Mariana Butte Golf Course, at 701 Clubhouse Dr, Loveland, is a City of Loveland municipal course open to the public, in Larimer County. Two independent aggregators, ForeTee and GolfPass, agree on its type as public/municipal, its par of 72, its architect Dick Phelps, and that it first opened for play in 1992. Book by phone at (970) 667-8308; the city's own booking site and facility pages return only a browser-verification page to automated requests, so no operator quote or online booking link is published here. No yardage is published, since the sources disagree on the figure, and no green fee is published, since none carries a date.

sections.heading: Dining in Loveland
sections.body: Door 222 Food & Drink, at 222 E. 4th Street in downtown Loveland, describes itself on its own site as "Upscale Casual Dining in Downtown Loveland," with "a creative menu featuring modern twists on traditional cuisine." It is open Tuesday through Sunday, from 4:00 pm until close; phone (970) 541-3020.

faq.question: How do I book a tee time at TPC Colorado?
faq.answer: TPC Colorado is not an unrestricted public course. Non-members book by phone on (970) 663-5063, up to seven days in advance. The club states that non-member tee times are available Monday through Thursday after 11:00 AM and Friday through Sunday after 1:00 PM, subject to availability. It also states that Thursday through Sunday are reserved for TPC Colorado members and the TPC Network, with any remaining starting times released for sale only 24 hours in advance. The club's own wording places Thursday in both categories, so a Thursday time should be confirmed by phone.

faq.question: Can I get a weekend tee time at TPC Colorado?
faq.answer: Not reliably, and not in advance. The club reserves Thursday through Sunday to its membership and the TPC Network, and any leftover starting times for those days are released to the public only 24 hours out. A visitor wanting a Saturday or Sunday round without waiting on a leftover time should plan on Mariana Butte Golf Course instead, a City of Loveland municipal course open to the public, bookable by phone at (970) 667-8308.

faq.question: Does playing TPC Colorado require staying at a hotel or resort?
faq.answer: No. Nothing on the club's site conditions play on a hotel or resort stay, and TPC Colorado has no lodging of its own.

faq.question: What does a round at TPC Colorado cost?
faq.answer: No green fee is published here. No figure found for TPC Colorado carries a date or a season, and the club's own rates page does not exist publicly. The club quotes its own rate when you call to book.
